name: 06820 · Darien, CT
findings: ZIP 06820 (Darien) has 155 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06820 (Darien) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 06820 (Darien) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 48% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
